rationale: Henry brings CTO-level expertise in ML infrastructure from AIEngine, while Karpurapu is an award-winning ML researcher at SJSU with hands-on experience in computer vision and full-stack development across Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript. This is a strong mentor–mentee pairing where Henry's industry perspective on ML systems can directly inform Karpurapu's research trajectory, and Karpurapu's cutting-edge research background could expose Henry to emerging academic approaches in AI.
intro_message: Henry Kendall, meet Karpurapu himavanth — Henry leads ML infrastructure at AIEngine, and Karpurapu is a Sr Researcher at SJSU with award-winning work in ML and computer vision; great opportunity to exchange perspectives on production systems vs. research innovation.
